demo.topics.welcome.title: Welcome to WojteX. Make yourself at home and say hello!
demo.topics.welcome.body:
## This is your new community

A place for good conversations, bold ideas, and projects you want to share with the world.

**Where to start?** Introduce yourself in a reply, explore the categories, and create your first topic.

> You can remove this topic and the demo profiles after exploring the forum.
demo.topics.projects.title: What are you building? Share your projects 🚀
demo.topics.projects.body:
I am working on a small tool for organizing my game library. What about you?

Share a description, some code, or an idea you would like to build with someone.
demo.topics.setups.title: Your gaming and work setups
demo.topics.setups.body:
Minimalist setup or full RGB? I would love to see the spaces where you work and play.

Mine has two monitors, a small keyboard, and definitely too many cables.
demo.topics.git.title: Git without the stress: five commands to get started
demo.topics.git.body:
## A small toolkit that makes a difference

```bash
git status
git add .
git commit -m "First step"
git log --oneline
git diff
```

Check `git diff` before each commit. It helps you see exactly what you are saving.
demo.topics.learning.title: Rust, Go, or TypeScript — what are you learning this year?
demo.topics.learning.body:
Every language solves slightly different problems. What did you learn from your first project?

I am especially interested in stories from practice.
demo.topics.wins.title: Small wins of the week ✨
demo.topics.wins.body:
I finally finished a feature I had been putting off for a month.

Share something that went well for you recently, even if it was a small thing.
demo.topics.asking.title: How do you describe a problem so people can help?
demo.topics.asking.body:
Include **what you want to achieve**, **what is happening**, and **how to reproduce it**.

Remove passwords and tokens before sharing logs. A short example often helps more than a whole project.
demo.topics.weekend.title: What should we play together this weekend?
demo.topics.weekend.body: We are looking for a game for a relaxed evening: cooperation, good fun, and an easy way to join. What would you suggest?
demo.replies.first: Great topic! I am saving this and will come back with my own example.
